correctness.rationale: For each coordinate vertex the sum of the four selected-neighbor indicators is exactly one if and only if the eight successor bits are the indicated Boolean values. Every toroidal code corresponds bijectively to an initial ordered-column pair fixed by t forward iterations. The provided integer-only verifier checks all 65,536 ordered states, finds 1,156 defined edges, and exhaustively identifies four directed cycles of length 4 and sixteen of length 8. Functional-graph traversal is exhaustive and counts 4*4+16*8 fixed states when 8 divides t, 4*4 when 4 but not 8 divides t, and zero otherwise. A separate direct exact-neighborhood-cover algorithm independently verifies the six finite test lengths 3,4,5,6,8,12 (0,16,0,0,144,16). The infinite-range statement follows from the finite-state bijection, not numerical extrapolation.

originality.rationale: The 2007/2008 source gives parallel total-perfect-code existence; the fully inspected 2014 primary Section 5.1 explicitly leaves first factor eight untreated in its toroidal existence conjecture, proving only first factor 3 through 7. The 2015/2016 primary article explicitly restates that status. The present result addresses all EOD sets, not just parallel ones, and gives a full two-period classification and labeled count. Targeted literature and mathematical-record queries for the exact problem, aliases and stronger toroidal characterizations identified no covering result. The uninspected 2007/2008 full text and later/unindexed work remain originality risks.
residual_risks: The entire 2007/2008 foundational paper was not read; its abstract and subsequent primary statements are not substitutes for its complete text.
A later or unindexed proof of the entire conjecture or of the precise width-eight census may exist despite targeted searches; novelty and priority have not been independently certified.
Exhaustive state classification relies on executable finite certificate and self-review replay; no external audit has occurred.

value.rationale: Circumference eight is the first factor not covered by the explicitly posed 2014 torus conjecture and its proved width-3-through-7 cases. The result resolves that exact first unhandled infinite slice, shows all its total perfect codes are forced to period 4 or 8, and determines the complete exact labeled counting function for all t. These are structural limits on two-dimensional perfect-neighborhood tilings rather than an arbitrary small-parameter recomputation; no general-conjecture resolution is asserted.
